name: Toy Factory
author: Addicting Games
description: Toy Factory is a fun puzzle game where you need to help the toys escape! This is a cute puzzle game where there are a variety of toys looking to be freed! There are bunnies, aliens, rubber ducks, and teddy bears that want to get out of this stuffy toy store. Match 3 or more of the blocks to help the desperate toys come down to be able to get out of there. There are 45 levels of this game waiting to be solved by you! This is a colorfully decorated game with cheerful music playing in the background. The blocks are adorned with bold colors and images of unicorns, rockets, spaceships, and other fun characters. You can find your level and current score along the top of the game. From the main menu, select the High Scores to see where you stand against other Toy Factory players. Play until you’re at the top of the list!
